# COSS UI — pinned copy-owned snapshot

This directory is a **static, pinned snapshot** of five files from the MIT side
of the COSS UI monorepo. The upstream project describes its distribution model
as copy-paste-and-own, so this tree is copied once, owned here, and never
regenerated by a materializer. There is no re-vendoring script: replacing the
snapshot means copying the files again from a newer pinned SHA by hand and
updating this record.

## Source

- Repository: <https://github.com/cosscom/coss>
- Commit (pinned): `e43fa4a8da4c490ebf3e1e1707b2a9af6fa2a217`

| File here            | Upstream path at that commit                   |
| -------------------- | ---------------------------------------------- |
| `lib/utils.ts`       | `apps/ui/registry/default/lib/utils.ts`        |
| `ui/badge.tsx`       | `apps/ui/registry/default/ui/badge.tsx`        |
| `ui/card.tsx`        | `apps/ui/registry/default/ui/card.tsx`         |
| `ui/progress.tsx`    | `apps/ui/registry/default/ui/progress.tsx`     |
| `ui/separator.tsx`   | `apps/ui/registry/default/ui/separator.tsx`    |

The only edit applied to the copied bytes is the module-alias rewrite
`@/registry/default/lib/utils` → `../lib/utils.ts`, so every import in this tree
either stays inside this tree or names one of the npm packages the guard
allowlists. `bun scripts/vendor-coss.ts --verify webui/vendor/coss` enforces
that fail-closed.

The colour tokens are NOT copied from upstream CSS: `apps/ui/app/globals.css`
imports the AGPL package's stylesheet on its first line. They are derived from
the MIT registry item `apps/ui/public/r/style.json` (field `cssVars`) at the
same commit and live in `webui/src/index.css`.

## npm dependencies

Declared by `apps/ui/package.json` at the pinned commit, and mirrored verbatim
into this repository's `devDependencies`:

- `@base-ui/react`: `1.6.0`
- `class-variance-authority`: `^0.7.1`
- `clsx`: `^2.1.1`
- `tailwind-merge`: `^3.4.0`

## Licence

The repository root is AGPLv3. Only `apps/origin/` and `apps/ui/` are MIT, and
this snapshot copies exclusively from `apps/ui/`. The upstream `LICENSING.md` at
the pinned commit reads, verbatim:

````
# Licensing

This repository uses a mixed licensing approach. The default license for this project is [AGPLv3.0](LICENSE).
````
